speaker: Doctor
text: It seems there may be a misunderstanding; as Dr. Agent, I need to ask you questions to understand your specific symptoms and medical history. Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing gait and limb ataxia, and have you noticed any associated weakness or numbness?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; "looking drunk" and clumsiness on the right side are concerning signs. To better understand the severity and location of the issue, have you experienced any difficulty with your speech, swallowing, or vision in recent weeks?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
